The application is built, verified, and ready for your review.

**Open it here: http://maker:4000**

It starts on the empty welcome screen (a brand-new collection). Everything we agreed on is live and working with real saving and storage — go ahead and use it for real: paste a link and Save, search, add tags and a note, mark something to read later, archive or delete.

**Verification report (all passing):**

- **Behaviour tests — one per flow we approved (12 end-to-end checks in a real browser):** saving with auto-filled details and newest-first order; searching across title/site/address/description/tags/notes with a clear no-results state; tags with reuse suggestions; formatted notes; editing title/description (with the blank-title→address fallback); read-later and the reading-list tab; archive/restore (and archiving clearing the read-later mark); delete with confirmation; duplicate prevention (active links offer an edit shortcut, archived ones point you to Archive); invalid input refused; and the empty welcome state. **All 12 pass.**
- **Internal quality tests (17 checks)** over the underlying rules — URL validation, duplicate matching, tag normalisation, search matching, status transitions, and the auto-details fallback. **All 17 pass.**

A note on honesty about the environment: when you save a real external link, the app fetches that page's details on the server side. If this review container can't reach the outside internet, the app still saves the link and gives it a sensible name from its address — exactly the "never lose it" behaviour you approved — and you can edit the title/description yourself.

Two things we deliberately set aside for later (not part of what you approved to build now): fine-tuning how *quick* saving feels, and polishing the phone/desktop layout. The layout is already responsive; these are refinements, not missing features.

**Do you accept this software as meeting the behaviour we approved, and agree to complete this cycle?** If anything doesn't behave the way we agreed, tell me and I'll treat it as a fix within this cycle; if it's a new idea or a change to what we agreed, I'll record it for a future cycle.
